en: A monochrome (black‑and‑white) postcard view of a pond or small lake in the foreground, bordered by grass and trees. Across the water stands a large, multi-storey villa or residential building with a gabled roof and timber-framed upper section. To the right are additional lower buildings and a line of trees. A path runs along the edge of the pond with a few small human figures visible. In the top right corner, red printed text identifies the location as Freiberg i. Sa., Johannis-Anlagen.
